name: zc_terminal_look

tests.name: the Live Terminal is open with its companion terminals on screen

detail.note: THE PRECONDITION. Every clause below is a pixel reading, and a shut terminal returns a beautifully consistent set of readings of the world behind it.

tests.name: the i.Wonder mark reports its own rectangle, so it has painted and can be found

detail.note: the accessor returns false before the widget paints, so a caller cannot mistake an unpainted terminal for a missing emblem.

tests.name: the mark's rectangle is a small part of the terminal, not the whole panel

detail.note: THE CONTROL FOR THE PLATE CLAUSE. If this rectangle were the terminal, it would be mostly dark plate no matter what the emblem looked like, and E06 would pass by construction.

tests.name: the founder's own terminal accent was put back
each terminal is painted in the accent that was picked, not merely told about it

detail.note: GetPaintedAccent is the value FollowTheme last wrote into the brushes, so this separates a theme that took from one that was set and ignored.

tests.name: the accent change is visible in the terminal's own pixels, in the channel that was moved

detail.note: THE FOUNDER'S 'more apparent', asked of the pixels. Each accent is checked in ITS OWN channel across the two runs, because a reading that moves when two channels move at once cannot say which one it saw.

tests.name: the i.Wonder mark is still yellow with the chrome driven to blue and to green

detail.note: the emblem's gold is hard-coded on purpose -- 'It must be YELLOW' -- while the chrome follows the accent. So a warm mark surviving a blue terminal is the emblem being drawn AND being independent of the theme, in one reading.

tests.name: the mark sits on the terminal's own ground, with no plate of its own filling its rectangle

detail.note: 'I do NOT want yellow logo inside gray shape.' The mark is drawn as strokes -- a ring, the twin curves and a wave -- which cover well under half of their own bounding box, so most of that box has to still be the dark ground. A plate would fill it. The terminal's own figure is reported beside it for scale.

tests.name: the mark sits in the lower left of its terminal

detail.note: HALF THE FOUNDER'S SENTENCE. 'Bottom left' is measurable from the two rectangles; 'above the horizontal divider' is not, because the divider has no accessor -- so this does not claim it. The captures carry that half.

tests.name: the two accent runs are actually different pictures

detail.note: THE SECOND CONTROL. Flat on both sides means the instrument or the terminal is broken, not that the emblem is admirably stable -- and that is the shape of every vacuous pass this tree has produced.
